recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast close-up portrait of a woman with short blonde hair, characterized by a dramatic split-lighting effect where one side of the face is in deep shadow. The aesthetic is defined by 1970s film grain, a warm earthy color palette, and left-aligned serif typography tucked into the upper-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Dramatic contrast between the illuminated left side of the face and the shadowed right side.
Tight framing that crops the top of the head and shoulders to emphasize the eyes.
Text placement in the negative space of the upper-left corner, balancing the heavy visual weight of the face.
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated color palette favoring ochre, brown, and muted blue.
Soft-focus edges on the hair and background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is the primary subject, centered horizontally but slightly offset to the right, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye (viewer's left), which is sharply lit and positioned near the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the bright text in the upper left, moves down to the illuminated eye, and follows the curve of the jawline into the shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the upper-left corner and the deep shadows on the right side of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ochres in the skin tones and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark brown in the shadows on the right side.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sky blue in the top-line text and the shirt collar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast (chiaroscuro lighting).
paletteRestrictions: No neon or vibrant primary colors.
Avoid clean whites; use cream or off-white for highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke contrast between thick and thin lines.
Tight letter spacing (tracking) typical of 1970s phototypesetting.

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single word or short phrase per line

treatment.texture: Slightly grainy to match the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different colors and sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tight 70s serif aesthetic with high contrast.
A standard alternative that mimics the transitional serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight portrait of a woman with short blonde hair in a 1970s style. Use chiaroscuro lighting so the right side of her face is in deep shadow. The background should be a blurred, warm brown field. Apply heavy film grain and a soft-focus lens effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of text in the upper-left corner using a high-contrast serif font. The top line should be muted blue and the block below it should be cream-colored. Use tight leading and left alignment.

verificationChecks: Is the right side of the face significantly darker than the left?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif with tight spacing?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones and muted blue?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the shadow on the right side of the face
Specific hue of the blue accent text
Tightness of the crop on the subject's head
mustRedesign: Any modern digital sharpening or HDR effects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is tucked into the upper-left corner.
Verify the chiaroscuro lighting effect on the face.
Confirm the color palette is warm and muted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight 70s Portrait + Chiaroscuro Lighting + High-Contrast Serif Typography + Heavy Film Grain
